entry.title: Commission designates ChatGPT, Reddit, Roblox under Digital Services Act*
entry.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 31 Aug 2026 Today, the Commission has designated ChatGPT as a Very Large Online Search Engine (VLOSE), as well as Reddit and Roblox as Very Large Online Platforms (VLOPs), under the Digital Services Act (DSA).
